name: Le Meridien Columbus, The Joseph
positioning: Art-filled boutique Le Meridien hotel in the Short North Arts District of downtown Columbus, Ohio
best_for: Art lovers who want hundreds of works on display and free museum entry with their key card
Travelers who want a walkable base near Short North galleries, restaurants and shops
Couples who want spa treatments in a private spa suite

facts.text: The hotel is a boutique hotel in the Short North Arts District of downtown Columbus, steps from High Street's restaurants, shops and galleries.
Italian Village, North Market, the Greater Columbus Convention Center, Nationwide Arena and downtown Columbus are all within a mile of the hotel.
The hotel has two art programmes, and over 500 pieces of art are on display in the hotel.
The pieces on loan from the Pizzuti collection include works by international artists such as KAWS, Rob Wynne, Nari Ward and Fred Wilson.
The Joseph Editions, Ohio Portfolio features limited-edition master printed originals by 15 contemporary artists, each with an Ohio connection.
The rooms and executive suites overlook the Short North Arts District.
Rooms and suites feature handcrafted decor and floor-to-ceiling windows.
Each room has a Nespresso machine.
The Guild House is a signature Cameron Mitchell restaurant serving American cuisine with locally sourced ingredients.
Soul at The Joseph is a cafe by day and a lounge with seasonal craft cocktails by night.
The fitness center has Technogym equipment, Peloton bikes and free weights.
The hotel offers a complimentary bike rental programme.

highlights.text: Pieces on loan from the private art collection of Ron and Ann Pizzuti are on view throughout the bar and reception areas.
The Ohio Portfolio art is on view in the guest rooms, and all pieces are available for purchase.
Spa Suites offer private spa treatments in a personal setting, with custom stone and marble decor, rain showers and adjacent relaxation lounge areas.
Guests get complimentary general admission to the Columbus Museum of Art and the Columbus Museum of Art at The Pizzuti, one block from the hotel, by presenting their hotel key card.
The hotel hosts Le Petit Chef, an immersive dining experience with dishes from The Guild House.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
The hotel does not accept cash; a credit or debit card is required for payment.
